Hi Sasha — thanks for the note and great to hear you want to proceed. Quick answers up front, and I attached a workbook and PO template so you can see line-level mapping.

- Volume smoothing: yes — we can support an annualized commit with quarterly true-ups. Typical structure is: 12-month commitment (annual $ commitment), quarterly reconciliation (true-up/credit), and a smoothing tolerance band (±10% each quarter) before list-price true-up applies.

- Channel margin / reseller: we do support reseller pass-throughs on GCP private offers. Baseline pass-through is 15% (net to partner), with accelerated tiers at higher ARR. Partner must sign our reseller addendum and be a certified partner (sales + technical enablement).

Thanks for the ping — quick thoughts on margins and partner requirements: 

1) Margin bands (recommended):
- Baseline pass-through: 14% net to partner for deals <$250k ARR equivalent
- Growth tier: 18% net to partner for $250k–$1.2M ARR
- Acceleration: 22% net to partner for >$1.2M ARR

We can make 18% happen at the mid-tier if they commit to a 12-month ramp schedule and sign the reseller addendum. 18% across the board is risky for unit economics unless we apply list-price anchoring or a higher commit.

2) Partner eligibility: require: reseller addendum signed, evidence of GCP reseller status (channel partner ID), a short enablement training (we can do an enablement call), and proof of business (W9 / tax doc for payment routing).

3) Deal protections: recommend a 12-month list-price parity clause (no selling under the net price on equivalent SKUs) and a quarterly true-up mechanism with credits applied to the next invoice rather than retroactive cash refunds.

4) Co-sell credit idea: if Acme does joint marketing or case study within 6 months, we can offer a 1% one-time bonus to partner margin (paid as a one-time credit).

I'll attach a short partner_eligibility_checklist.pdf to formalize items to collect.
